name: Runemaster: Zenith resets on Manastorm stage transfer (#13679)
contract: Issue #13679: Runemaster Zenith (712325, 45 s RecoveryTime) remained on cooldown when
teleporting to the next Manastorm floor while all normal cooldowns reset.
ManastormMgr::OnPlayerEnterMap calls Player::RemoveAllSpellCooldown() on stage transfer.
AscensionRunemasterEchoes mirrors Zenith's cooldown into a persistent player setting
ledger ('core.runemaster.echoes') and the backing Echoes charge pool ('core.spell_charge.712389').
Because Player::RemoveAllSpellCooldown() neither cleared that ledger nor restored the
Zenith with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY and SendAscensionRunemasterEchoesCooldown() re-sent the
stale cooldown to the client. Player cooldown-clear paths now notify
OnPlayerSpellCooldownsCleared, resetting the Zenith ledger, restoring 712389 charges to 2,
and sending the clear cooldown packet. Casts 59752 (120 s control) and 712325 on floor 1,
defeats Taragaman to transfer to floor 2, and proves 59752 and 712325 both reset and 712325
recasts immediately on floor 2 well within its 45 s cooldown.
